acceptance_rule: AND(SOURCE,TARGET_RUNTIME,EXTERNAL); missing necessary evidence blocks acceptance

nodes.falsifier: Any missing child, forged PASS or unverified external authority leaves global BLOCKED.
Novice cannot discover candidates or distinguish them from tool execution.
Unknown ID or unconsented tool triggers subprocess, network, installation, scanning or approval.
Contract or CLI is detached from the original owner, package or exact-HEAD tests.
Without independent host, target runtime and usability study product acceptance is not supported.

nodes.acceptance: Ten typed upstream owners, handoffs and all seven existing CORA processes.
Bounded deterministic intents yield ranked candidates and matched terms, no tool execution.
nodes.falsifier: Injection, unrelated intent or hidden execution yields false readiness or PASS.

nodes.acceptance: Exact allowlisted version/help probe only after explicit consent, bounded execution.
nodes.falsifier: Unknown tool, unconsented subprocess, oversized output or timeout accepted as success.
nodes.oracle: Mocked bounded runner plus real hosted CI

nodes.acceptance: Upstream retains installs, code, acceptance, release and identities.
nodes.falsifier: Discovery or unverified evidence becomes approval.

nodes.acceptance: One CORA CLI, one process owner, no duplicate scanner/agent/policy engine.
nodes.falsifier: Second CLI, missing docs or source census drift.

nodes.acceptance: Native tests and concluded GitHub CI checked at the exact PR SHA.
nodes.falsifier: Status for another SHA, skip, timeout or pending presented as all green.
nodes.oracle: GitHub exact-head CI and comprehensive replay

roadmap.outcome: Discover and infer upstream tools through process-list
Canonical contract, integration/readback in real Git, no duplicate owner
Independent host and usability validation; optional upstream tool integration

development: Pin actual main commit and target ownership
Patch original source owner, not a new engine
Preserve native CLI and backwards-compatible schemas
tests: Test unknown ID and no authorization
Test bounded probe and missing binary
Test exact-SHA CI and no false PASS
cleanup: No new installer, network client, policy engine
Update canonical contract index and atlas
No deletion based solely on static imports
closure: Git blob/tree readback on feature branch
Native test exit and failing IDs
All GitHub CI conclusions for exact HEAD
